sources.quote: 8.5.6.1 A change of material source, of a sub-supplier, or of the manufacturing location of a sub-supplier needs a documented risk analysis and written approval from Stellantis before any shipment of affected parts.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6
Annex A: programs STL-Torino-27 and STL-Torino-31.

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to STL-Torino-27 (Annex A of the STL CSR). Moving billet homogenisation to a new toll processor, Termica Nord, is a change of sub-supplier or manufacturing location. It needs a documented risk analysis and written STL approval before shipment. No document in force covers it.

sources.quote: APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)
An approval covers the named manufacturing location only.
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.

findings.why: AP-0311 covers only Alluminio B at Settimo Torinese. The ASL is the complete list for BR-220 at TO1 for STL. Homogenisation at Termica Nord is a different manufacturing location and is not listed, so it has no current approval.

sources.quote: Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01 | Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat
Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.

findings.why: The meeting only states "Same 6082-T6 spec". No certificate or test result shows that billet homogenised at Termica Nord meets EN AW-6082-T6 and Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). Someone must supply a 3.1 certificate and tensile results for this processing route.
